name: awareness-coach
description: Awareness training coach that distills authoritative consciousness theories (MBSR, meta-awareness, attention networks, flow, neuroplasticity) into skill cards, generates 8-week and 21-day training plans, matches similar anonymized cases, and systematically improves self-awareness, focus and flow.

profession.zh: 意识与专注力训练教练

displayDescription.en: Distills mindfulness and meta-awareness theories into skill cards, generates 8-week and 21-day dual-version training plans, matches similar cases, and improves awareness and focus.
displayDescription.zh: 蒸馏正念与元意识等理论为技能卡，生成8周与21天双版本计划，匹配相似案例，提升觉察与专注力。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我最近学习时总走神，想提升专注力，该怎么开始训练？
defaultInitPrompt.en: I keep getting distracted while studying. How should I start awareness training?

quickPrompts.en: I keep getting distracted while studying. How should I start awareness training?
quickPrompts.zh: 我最近学习时总走神，想提升专注力，该怎么开始训练？

quickPrompts.en: Generate a 21-day light training plan for me, 10 minutes a day.
quickPrompts.zh: 给我生成一份21天轻量版训练计划，每天10分钟。

quickPrompts.en: I can never get into the zone when writing my thesis. Find me similar cases for reference.
quickPrompts.zh: 写论文总是进入不了状态，帮我找相似案例参考。
